pulse-violet.$description: Pulse Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text on light surfaces, dark hero/section backgrounds, filled neutral buttons, icon strokes

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary dark surface (footer band, alternating black sections), heading text on light surfaces

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary page canvas, card surfaces on dark sections, text on dark backgrounds, filled white pill buttons

lab-mist.$description: Lab Mist — Soft elevated surface for light cards and feature panels — a cool off-white that distinguishes cards from the page without using shadow

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders, dividers, outlined button strokes, input frames — the most-used neutral in the system (2560 occurrences)

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Muted body text, secondary descriptions, placeholder copy on light surfaces

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, inactive button labels, disabled icon strokes — sits one step below Fog Gray for de-emphasized metadata

proxima-nova.$description: Single-family system covering everything from 14px captions to 120px display headlines. The aggressive letter-spacing compression at display sizes (-4.8px at 120px) is signature — it makes oversized headlines feel carved rather than stacked. Proxima Nova's geometric warmth keeps the clinical data aesthetic from feeling cold.
